Changes made
- Implemented optional TTL support and a testable clock in src/lru.ts.
- Constructor now accepts options: { ttl?: number; now?: () => number }.
  - ttl sets a default TTL in milliseconds for entries created without a per-entry TTL.
  - now is a function returning current time in ms (defaults to Date.now) for testing.
- set(key, value, ttlMs?) accepts an optional per-entry ttl in ms; passing undefined means the entry never expires (unless a default ttl was provided).
- Expired entries are purged and behave as if they were never present:
  - get returns undefined, has returns false, size and keys ignore expired entries.
- When inserting and capacity is reached, purgeExpired() is run first so expired entries are removed before evicting any live entry.
- Existing behavior preserved when no options are provided; old calls like new LRUCache(2) still work.
- Tests: ran the existing test suite; all 7 tests pass.

If you'd like, I can:
1. Add unit tests specifically for TTL behavior and the now injection.
2. Optimize purge strategy to avoid scanning the whole map on every size/keys call (tradeoffs exist).
